findings_addressed.oracle: Frozen independent set frozenset({'1', '2', '3'}) and frozen list ['smbios_type_1_launch_arg', 'smbios_type_2_launch_arg', 'smbios_type_3_launch_arg', 'cpuid_hypervisor_mask_launch_arg'] hand-maintained separately from any production helper. The tautological oracle that called QEMUSandbox._anti_evasion_smbios_entries via smbios_entries_for_test() was replaced with hard-coded audit-specified literals so a regression in the production method cannot corrupt both sides of the assertion in lockstep.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/sandbox/qemu.py _anti_evasion_smbios_entries default branch (line ~1659), remove the type-2 entry so it returns only [{'type': '1', ...}, {'type': '3', ...}]; reported_smbios_types becomes frozenset({'1', '3'}) which != frozenset({'1', '2', '3'}) and techniques != frozen_launch_techniques, failing both assertions.

deletions.covered_by: Removed because it was only used as the tautological oracle; the hardened test uses a hard-coded frozen set instead and no other code in the file called this helper.

notes: The finding was a true tautology: expected_smbios_types was built by calling QEMUSandbox._anti_evasion_smbios_entries('default') via the smbios_entries_for_test shim, and reported_smbios_types was derived from the techniques that apply_anti_evasion built using the same method. Both sides derived from the same production code. The fix replaces the oracle with the frozen audit-specified type set {'1','2','3'} and the frozen expected technique list, both of which are hard-coded literals independent of any production helper. The unused smbios_entries_for_test static method was removed as it had no remaining callers.
